data.label: Brainstorm project ideas

data.description: Formulate testable statements based on project ideas.

data.description: Create initial versions of the project for testing.

data.description: Gather feedback from users on the prototypes.

data.description: Assess the performance and usability of the prototypes.

data.description: Conduct experiments to validate the proposed hypotheses.

data.description: Organize findings to include in the research paper.
